event.description:
A fun Friday night filled with hits written by the legendary metal group System of a Down, performed by Fargo’s premiere SOAD cover band

Welcome to the Pastime Activity Halloween Eve show at TAK Music Venue! Get ready for a spooktacular night filled with good music, good food, and a frightful amount of fun. Join us on October 30, 2026 at 7:15 PM (Central Time) for a thrilling evening you won’t forget. Local goth metal group FAYRE begin the evening and then the Pastime Activity group are bringing their tribute show featuring two full sets of System of a Down songs with hits from all five albums. Come dressed in your best costume and enjoy a night of entertainment with friends or your family. Don’t miss out on this holiday extravaganza!

FOR THE 2026 PERFORAMNCE – to celebrate the 25th anniversary of the iconic album “TOXICITY”, Pastime Activity will play the entire songlist in track order for their second set.

The night will once again feature culinary delights to purchase from Deb’s Corner Foods! Deb returns as the official vendor for the evening, serving delicious meals and snacks to please the palates of carnivorous and vegetarian/vegan attendees alike. Deb’s concessions will be available as soon as the doors open and will continue through the end of intermission or until supplies run out. The venue will also have a variety of cold beverages available for purchase, including plenty of options for attendees seeking adult libations from the bar (with proof of ID; to be verified at the door and 21+ wristband provided to be worn throughout the event).

All ticket holders will have access to using a table for enjoying the performance. Seated tables (small round, seats up to 4 patrons) are available as VIP tables during online presale only. General admission will include access to standing room and unreserved high-top tables (accommodates 2-3 patrons comfortably).

  • General Admission: $10 – For those that enjoy standing during a show, this ticket includes the tables closest to the back; tables are unassigned
  • ADA Admission: $10
  • VIP Table Admission: $15 – For those that enjoy sitting during a show, this ticket includes the round tables closest to the front. Seats will not be assigned and will be available on a first-come-first-served basis.
  • FRONT ROW TABLES: $75 – small round table reserved in the row closest to the stage. Will seat up to four concertgoers. Price of the table includes admission for up to 4 persons to the event. All tables purchased will be assigned in the order that they were received, and will be reserved with the name of the ticket purchaser.

STUDENTS: Show your valid school ID to receive $10 admission at the door!!! This includes Junior/Senior High, and all College/University student identification cards.

Any remaining general admission tickets will be sold for $15 at the door (cash price; credit card fees apply to all at-the-door ticket sales)

event.description:
Duluth’s Saltydog returns for a very salty and greasy All Hallow’s Eve with The Godfathers of Grease on Friday, October 30th!!! Bring your best outfit as we are kicking it early for the holiday. There will be a costume contest!

TICKETS AVAILABLE NOW! https://holdmyticket.com/tickets/467535

7pm Doors | 8PM Music | 21+

Saltydog is a funk jam Improvisational exploration that takes the audience & band on a journey through their playfully crafted folk driven tunes inspired by the likes of everyone from The Talking Heads, The Band, those classic country and jam band staples along with everyone in between.

The band spawned on the banks of Duluth’s ice covered stones by brothers Jacob and Owen Mahon. This midwestern psychedelic cowboy review features Calvin (Calzone) Lund, Lefty Johnson, Gavin St. Clair, and Sam Deters.

The Godfathers of Grease is a funk driven band that writes crazy original that fight of the world’s evil. Holding many members you may know from various projects in the Fargo-Moorhead area, you’ll come to quickly love TGOG. They crushed it for year one of Swingstock in celebration of Swing Barrel and downtown Moorhead. Come fall in love with these regional cool cats.

Blackout Skate

While there is still enough visibility to navigate the skating floor, the darker environment creates a concert-style atmosphere. Glow Sticks

Get a FREE glow stick for every paid skater! We want everyone to enjoy the glow night and create a fun, glowing atmosphere, so we provide every paid skater with a glow stick on us!

Great Music & Games

We pick great music for dancing and skating for this Friday night session. Nothing pairs with specialty lights and blackout skates like songs with a good rhythm!

event.description:
Safe Harbor is a small, in-person, facilitated community peer-support and emotional processing group set up to offer more human connection.

The group will run in 4-week closed cycles, with up to 10 members each cycle, and will be meeting for about 90 minutes on the weekend. This is a non-therapy, community-based space, and it is not a substitute for therapy or crisis services.

Safe Harbor may be a good fit for people experiencing grief, transition, relational stress, feeling overwhelmed, or just wanting a place to process life with others humans.

Please note, this group is not a fit for anyone in immediate crisis. If you need urgent support, please call or text 988.

If you are interested, you can learn more about the group, facilitator, and also complete a quick interest form at safeharborfm.org

event.description:
Halloween. Magic. And 48 booster packs we’ve been saving for exactly this kind of nonsense. Join us Halloween afternoon for All Leylines’ Eve, a special Chaos Booster Draft featuring Magic sets from across the years! We’ve put together 96 packs for just 32 players, and we’re not talking about a pile of recent boosters.

Ultimate Masters. Eternal Masters. Time Spiral. Kaladesh. Iconic Masters. Masters 25. And plenty more.

Every player will draft three packs, but exactly which packs are waiting for you? We’re keeping some of that a surprise. That’s the CHAOS part. And this isn’t quite a normal game of Magic.

Every player receives a special Leyline of Anticipation promo and begins each game with it already on the battlefield. It isn’t part of your deck and doesn’t count toward your deck size.

What does Leyline of Anticipation do?

You may cast spells as though they had flash. Yes. ALL of your spells. That should make three rounds of Chaos Draft even more chaotic.

NEW SCRIPT IN FARGO: DIRTY MONEY
A corporate cover-up. Arson. Financial fraud. And a killer determined to make everyone involved pay.
Join The Dinner Detective for Dirty Money, a brand-new interactive comedy murder mystery dinner show in Fargo! Help uncover the truth behind a devastating crime while a killer, driven by grief and revenge, targets the people who buried it.
Show dates: October 3, October 31, November 14, November 28, and December 26
Saturdays, 6–9 PM
October 31 is our Costume Show! Come dressed up for a Halloween night of mystery.
Enjoy a full plated dinner while you follow clues, question suspects, and try to solve the case. The culprit is hiding somewhere in the room and you could become a Prime Suspect before the night is over!
The Dinner Detective is North America’s largest interactive comedy true-crime murder mystery dinner theatre show. Our actors blend into the audience instead of appearing in obvious costumes, making every conversation part of the fun. Your ticket includes the show, dinner, waitstaff gratuity, and plenty of surprises.
Gather your fellow sleuths and book your seats for Dirty Money’s Fargo debut!

event.description:
There is something special about a room full of gamers.

On any given Sunday at Paradox Comics-N-Cards, you might find adventurers exploring a forgotten dungeon, heroes saving a kingdom, rival starships battling across a tabletop, commanders shuffling up for one more game, or friends gathered around a board game they have been meaning to try for months. Sunday Game Day is our weekly celebration of tabletop gaming in all its forms.

The tables are open, the community is welcoming, and the possibilities are nearly endless. Bring your favorite board game, roleplaying game, miniature game, card game, or campaign group and settle in for an afternoon of gaming. Whether you arrive with a full party or come looking for fellow players, Sunday is one of the best times to connect with the local gaming community.

Roleplaying games are especially at home on Sundays. Gather your adventuring party, continue an ongoing campaign, introduce new players to the hobby, or launch something completely new. From Dungeons & Dragons to Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu, Star Wars, and countless other RPGs, our tables are available for stories waiting to be told.

Board gamers are equally welcome. Strategy games, family games, co-op adventures, deckbuilders, party games, and everything in between all have a place here. Our game library is available to browse, and you’re always welcome to bring games from home as well.

While open gaming is the heart of Sunday Game Day, we occasionally schedule organized events, demos, leagues, and special gaming activities throughout the year. If you enjoy tabletop gaming, we encourage you to bookmark the Paradox Comics-N-Cards event calendar and check back often. You never know when your next favorite game, campaign, or event might appear.

There is no entry fee for Sunday Game Day. Just bring your games, your imagination, and your sense of adventure.

Join us each month for different activities lead by experts in their respective disciplines. Any needed supplies will be provided.

event.description:
Loud enough to sing along. Loose enough to dance. Strong enough to order another.
We’re turning Tuesdays into a full-on dive bar music night. Barstool Sessions is all about live music, cold drinks, bad decisions, and good times—right here at Mick’s Office.
We rotate every Tuesday:
 Open Mic Night
 7:30 PM – 10:30 PM
Got songs? Got guts? Grab the mic.
• Play 2–3 songs
• First come, first serve
• Paper sign-up sheet out at 6:30 PM
• No frills, no filters, just real music
 Gig Night – Paid
One local artist takes over from 7:30–9:30 PM, playing the hits, the favorites, and the kind of songs that get the bar singing, swaying, and spilling beer.
The goal: Get people dancing by the jukebox, singing like they mean it, and drinking like it’s Tuesday (because it is). We want artists to grow, bring their friends, scribble their socials on the chalkboard, and help us turn Mick’s Office into a weekly music-fueled mess—in the best way possible.
Pull up a barstool. Yell the lyrics. Buy the next round.

event.description:
Want to play Dungeons & Dragons without signing up for a months-long campaign?

D&D One-Shot Wednesdays are exactly what they sound like: self-contained adventures that begin and end in one night. Show up, grab a seat, and play.

Every Wednesday, we run two tables of one-shot adventures, designed to work for new players, returning players, and long-time D&D fans. No ongoing story to track, no pressure to commit — just a good night of rolling dice and telling a story together.

What this night is good for:

  • Trying D&D for the first time
  • Playing when your regular group can’t meet
    Dropping in for a single night of adventure

We’re also always interested in hearing from Dungeon Masters who enjoy running one-shots. If you like telling tight stories and meeting new players, this night was made for you.

Happens every Wednesday. Start with one night — stay as long as you like.

event.description:
There is something special about sitting down at a table with a good game, a few friends, and no rush to be anywhere else.

Every Thursday night, Paradox Comics-N-Cards opens the tables for a completely free evening of casual board gaming. Whether you are bringing your longtime favorite game, trying something brand new, or simply looking for a place to meet other people who enjoy boardgames, Thursday night is the perfect time to hang out at 814 Main Avenue. It’s relaxed, welcoming, and easy to jump into.

Bring your own games, teach something you love, learn something new, or just wander from table to table seeing what everyone is playing. Some groups will be deep into strategy games. Others might be laughing through party games, battling through co-op adventures, or introducing new players to modern board gaming for the very first time. No tournament pressure. No entry fee. Just a great night of gaming with good people.

You do not need a full group to attend. One of the best parts of board game night is meeting new players and discovering games you may never have tried otherwise. If you are new to tabletop gaming, this is also a great way to get started. Our community is filled with people who love sharing the hobby.

Our game library will be available to browse throughout the evening, and you are always welcome to bring games from home as well. Feel free to arrive early, stay late, grab snacks, settle in, and make a night of it.

If you have been looking for a regular place to unplug for a few hours, roll some dice, play some cards, and spend time with other gamers, Thursday nights at Paradox are for you.

Safe Harbor is a small, in-person, facilitated community peer-support and emotional processing group set up to offer more human connection.

The group will run in 4-week closed cycles, with up to 10 members each cycle, and will be meeting for about 90 minutes on the weekend. This is a non-therapy, community-based space, and it is not a substitute for therapy or crisis services.

Safe Harbor may be a good fit for people experiencing grief, transition, relational stress, feeling overwhelmed, or just wanting a place to process life with others humans.

Please note, this group is not a fit for anyone in immediate crisis. If you need urgent support, please call or text 988.

event.description:
Catering to families with young skaters, this Saturday morning session offers discounted admission for families along with age-appropriate music and skating aids at half off the regular price!

Help for Our Youngest Skaters

Our Family Skate is great for our newest skaters! We have Zippy Adjustable Skates, which go over the shoe, have a lower and wider wheel base, and roll more slowly. These are great for learning balance. We also rent Skate Mates for skaters aged 10 and under for $2.50 which is 1/2 off the regular price.

Discounted Admission for All

As families grow so do the expenses to go out and have fun together. We want to help and so during our Family Skate you can enjoy a lower admission at just $6 per skater. Don’t have your own skates? No problem! Rent your choice of inline or roller skates for just $4.00.

Themed Skate Sessions

Our Family Skate is a great session to host themed skates throughout the year. Whether celebrating a holiday or creating our own fun with a Superhero Skate, these can feature costumes, festivities and prizes, and themed music! Themed events may have special pricing on Admission.

event.description:
Learn about and taste the whiskies from J Henry & Sons with distillery representative Andrew Ready.

After battling to save his small farm amid the crisis of the 1980, Joe Henry was looking for a way to make his hard work permanent. One idea struck him – whiskey, made from heirloom grains grown on his family farm. His determination paid off, resulting in the brand J Henry & Sons. Built on the hard work of three generations of farmers, the whiskeys of J Henry are made from a unique four-grain recipe and aged in a barn exposed to the harsh Wisconsin climate. In this class, distillery representative Andrew Ready will lead you on a deep dive into the inner workings of J Henry and Sons. Expected to taste delicious, limited productions of Bourbons and Ryes while learning just what makes this distillery so special.

event.description:
There is something special about a room full of gamers.

On any given Sunday at Paradox Comics-N-Cards, you might find adventurers exploring a forgotten dungeon, heroes saving a kingdom, rival starships battling across a tabletop, commanders shuffling up for one more game, or friends gathered around a board game they have been meaning to try for months. Sunday Game Day is our weekly celebration of tabletop gaming in all its forms.

The tables are open, the community is welcoming, and the possibilities are nearly endless. Bring your favorite board game, roleplaying game, miniature game, card game, or campaign group and settle in for an afternoon of gaming. Whether you arrive with a full party or come looking for fellow players, Sunday is one of the best times to connect with the local gaming community.

Roleplaying games are especially at home on Sundays. Gather your adventuring party, continue an ongoing campaign, introduce new players to the hobby, or launch something completely new. From Dungeons & Dragons to Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu, Star Wars, and countless other RPGs, our tables are available for stories waiting to be told.

Board gamers are equally welcome. Strategy games, family games, co-op adventures, deckbuilders, party games, and everything in between all have a place here. Our game library is available to browse, and you’re always welcome to bring games from home as well.

While open gaming is the heart of Sunday Game Day, we occasionally schedule organized events, demos, leagues, and special gaming activities throughout the year. If you enjoy tabletop gaming, we encourage you to bookmark the Paradox Comics-N-Cards event calendar and check back often. You never know when your next favorite game, campaign, or event might appear.

There is no entry fee for Sunday Game Day. Just bring your games, your imagination, and your sense of adventure.

Meet up and chat with others with similar interests. Come with friends, or make some new ones! Refreshments will be provided.

Check the calendar for updates – https://larl.org/mondaymeetup/

First Monday of the Month – Craft Connection

Join us to get cozy, craft and chat! This is an opportunity to leave distractions behind and focus on your craft. Bring whatever project you are working on and meet up with other local crafters. You can share your expertise, learn from others or just enjoy some distraction-free time to yourself. Refreshments will be provided.

Second Monday of the Month – Best Sellers Book Club

Join the Moorhead Public Library’s Best Sellers Book Club and see what the buzz is about in the latest popular books!

Third Monday of the Month – Game Night

Join us to get cozy, play games, and chat! This is an opportunity to meet up with others who enjoy playing games. Come with friends, or make some new ones! Bring your favorite card or board game, or try one of ours! Refreshments will be provided.

Fourth Monday of the Month – Silent Reading Club

Join us at the Moorhead Library for quiet, sustained reading at our new Silent Book Club! All readers are welcome—ebooks or audiobooks, poetry or prose, fiction or non-fiction… it’s BYOBook. The library will provide comfortable seating and light refreshments.

Fifth Monday of the Month – Guided Activity

Join us each month for different activities lead by experts in their respective disciplines. Any needed supplies will be provided.

event.description:
Love? In Business? Yes! If your business is lovable, clients and employees will run toward you with the best
projects and great referrals.

“Building the Love Into Your Business” with Emily Cohen

Join us for our 3rd speaker event of our 2026-27 season, “Building the Love Into Your Business” with Emily Cohen, Founder & Partner at Casa Davka.

Presentation Overview:
Love? In Business? Yes! If your business is lovable, clients and employees will run toward you with the best projects and great referrals, possibly even arms full of chocolates and roses. But love isn’t a box full of beautifully packaged chocolates or fine wine. It’s not a fun poster or even a unique giveaway. It’s less tangible and something you give your clients and staff all year. In this inspiring talk, you’ll learn why infusing love across all aspects of your business is essential to your long-term success and the top strategies we have curated for building and sharing the love.

Speaker Bio:
Emily Cohen, Founder & Partner at Casa Davka, is a no-nonsense business consultant who has partnered with 500+ leading creative firms worldwide. At Casa Davka, Emily works holistically with our clients to envision and plan for their future and business growth, but has a particular passion and expertise in positioning, business development, and organizational development strategies.

Emily is a frequently requested main stage speaker within the creative industry and has spoken at hundreds of international, national, and local conferences and events for organizations such as: Creative Mornings, AIGA, Association of Registered Graphic Designers (RGD), and Creative South.

In 2018, she self-published her business book for creatives, Brutally Honest: No-bullshit business strategies to evolve your creative business. Brutally Honest has become a go-to business book for creative industry professionals worldwide, and several universities use it as a teaching tool.

Emily is a designer by degree, an avid reader, a dog-lover, a trend-spotter, a connection-builder, and an industry advocate.

Parking:

Attendees can park for free in lot M-5 that is West of the CMU off 6th Avenue South. See Google Maps to address here: https://maps.app.goo.gl/idoNT6dVpSoE1rpU9

Free & Open Play | All Skill Levels Welcome

Tuesday night is Commander night at Paradox Comics-N-Cards! Whether you’re a seasoned player with a carefully tuned deck or brand new to the format – or even to Magic – this night is for you.

Commander is all about big plays, wild moments, and great company, and we’ve created a space that makes it easy to jump in. Bring your own pod or come solo – our staff is happy to help you find a game, and many of our regulars love welcoming new players to the table.

Here’s what you can expect:

event.description:
Loud enough to sing along. Loose enough to dance. Strong enough to order another.
We’re turning Tuesdays into a full-on dive bar music night. Barstool Sessions is all about live music, cold drinks, bad decisions, and good times—right here at Mick’s Office.
We rotate every Tuesday:
 Open Mic Night
 7:30 PM – 10:30 PM
Got songs? Got guts? Grab the mic.
• Play 2–3 songs
• First come, first serve
• Paper sign-up sheet out at 6:30 PM
• No frills, no filters, just real music
 Gig Night – Paid
One local artist takes over from 7:30–9:30 PM, playing the hits, the favorites, and the kind of songs that get the bar singing, swaying, and spilling beer.
The goal: Get people dancing by the jukebox, singing like they mean it, and drinking like it’s Tuesday (because it is). We want artists to grow, bring their friends, scribble their socials on the chalkboard, and help us turn Mick’s Office into a weekly music-fueled mess—in the best way possible.
Pull up a barstool. Yell the lyrics. Buy the next round.

event.description:
Want to play Dungeons & Dragons without signing up for a months-long campaign?

D&D One-Shot Wednesdays are exactly what they sound like: self-contained adventures that begin and end in one night. Show up, grab a seat, and play.

Every Wednesday, we run two tables of one-shot adventures, designed to work for new players, returning players, and long-time D&D fans. No ongoing story to track, no pressure to commit — just a good night of rolling dice and telling a story together.

What this night is good for:

  • Trying D&D for the first time
  • Playing when your regular group can’t meet
    Dropping in for a single night of adventure

We’re also always interested in hearing from Dungeon Masters who enjoy running one-shots. If you like telling tight stories and meeting new players, this night was made for you.

Happens every Wednesday. Start with one night — stay as long as you like.

Bracket Night pits you and your favorite 100 Magic cards against new opponents using the new WotC Commander Brackets every week.

  • You’ll face new players every week! You know what your friends play, you know what to expect when you face them, but now you can switch it up!
  • See new Commanders! It’s not just your friends you know so well, it’s also their decks. What’s the next draw and play going to bring to your games here?
  • Get the experience of the Paradox Comics-N-Cards staff! Want to learn how cards interact or work? This is the perfect place to ask a judge and resolve those questions you’ve always wondered.
  • Help Paradox build the ultimate Commander gaming experience!
  • As you play different Brackets we’ll get your feedback and refine our Wednesday nights with your help!

For every experience level: Whether you’ve got a regular play group or you are looking to play Commander for the first time, Wednesday night is the place to be.

The Saints of Sickness Tour featuring VentanA, Deadly Apples, & Aeternum hits The Aquarium on Wednesday, November 11th.

TICKETS ON SALE NOW! https://tickets.holdmyticket.com/tickets/465479

7PM Doors • 7:30PM Music • 21+

VENTANA, is an industrial/metal band from Cleveland, Ohio. The band, founded by Richard “Stitch” Thomas and Daniel Fox (both ex-members of the band Mushroomhead, CROSSBREED and current members of The Ex-Faces, are announcing a headlining run this November titled “The Saints of Sickness Tour”
The release of their current single “Iron Over Blood” is already gaining traction amongst longtime fans and new listeners. Over the last 2 decades Ventana has played with many national acts like Fear Factory, Dope, Mushroomhead, Mindless Self Indulgence, Hellyeah, Static-X, Powerman 5000, Hed PE, Birthday Massacre  and performed on select days of Mayhem Festival. Ventana live performances are nonstop and high energy, engaging crowds to feel part of the show.
Promotional wording that can be used:
 “Featuring Ex-Mushroomhead members”
“Featuring current members of The Ex-Faces”
“For fans of Static-X / Marilyn Manson / Nine Inch Nails”
This tour also features Canadian Industrial/Rock band DEADLY APPLES as a co-headliner,  who have played numerous large festivals over the last decade and have  also toured with Marilyn Manson, Rob Zombie, Korn and Rammstein.. Their latest single “Volatile” features Richard Patrick {Filter} and Danny Lohner {Nine Inch Nails}, the song has already surpassed 1 million+ streams. With a large social media presence and underground following,  they are a strong addition to this club tour.
Also on the tour is up and coming band AETERNUM, an electro-industrial-pop band fronted by Kayla Smith. They just released their fierce single “Knives at Midnight” produced by multi-platinum artist Scott Wilson, the track is already gaining them momentum and increasing listeners and followers each day. Recently out on tour with bands like A Killers Confession and Dogma, they are quickly carving out their national touring footprint.

event.description:
There is something special about sitting down at a table with a good game, a few friends, and no rush to be anywhere else.

Every Thursday night, Paradox Comics-N-Cards opens the tables for a completely free evening of casual board gaming. Whether you are bringing your longtime favorite game, trying something brand new, or simply looking for a place to meet other people who enjoy boardgames, Thursday night is the perfect time to hang out at 814 Main Avenue. It’s relaxed, welcoming, and easy to jump into.

Bring your own games, teach something you love, learn something new, or just wander from table to table seeing what everyone is playing. Some groups will be deep into strategy games. Others might be laughing through party games, battling through co-op adventures, or introducing new players to modern board gaming for the very first time. No tournament pressure. No entry fee. Just a great night of gaming with good people.

You do not need a full group to attend. One of the best parts of board game night is meeting new players and discovering games you may never have tried otherwise. If you are new to tabletop gaming, this is also a great way to get started. Our community is filled with people who love sharing the hobby.

Our game library will be available to browse throughout the evening, and you are always welcome to bring games from home as well. Feel free to arrive early, stay late, grab snacks, settle in, and make a night of it.

If you have been looking for a regular place to unplug for a few hours, roll some dice, play some cards, and spend time with other gamers, Thursday nights at Paradox are for you.

event.description:
NEW SCRIPT IN FARGO: DIRTY MONEY
A corporate cover-up. Arson. Financial fraud. And a killer determined to make everyone involved pay.
Join The Dinner Detective for Dirty Money, a brand-new interactive comedy murder mystery dinner show in Fargo! Help uncover the truth behind a devastating crime while a killer, driven by grief and revenge, targets the people who buried it.
Show dates: October 3, October 31, November 14, November 28, and December 26
Saturdays, 6–9 PM
October 31 is our Costume Show! Come dressed up for a Halloween night of mystery.
Enjoy a full plated dinner while you follow clues, question suspects, and try to solve the case. The culprit is hiding somewhere in the room and you could become a Prime Suspect before the night is over!
The Dinner Detective is North America’s largest interactive comedy true-crime murder mystery dinner theatre show. Our actors blend into the audience instead of appearing in obvious costumes, making every conversation part of the fun. Your ticket includes the show, dinner, waitstaff gratuity, and plenty of surprises.
Gather your fellow sleuths and book your seats for Dirty Money’s Fargo debut!

event.description:
There is something special about a room full of gamers.

On any given Sunday at Paradox Comics-N-Cards, you might find adventurers exploring a forgotten dungeon, heroes saving a kingdom, rival starships battling across a tabletop, commanders shuffling up for one more game, or friends gathered around a board game they have been meaning to try for months. Sunday Game Day is our weekly celebration of tabletop gaming in all its forms.

The tables are open, the community is welcoming, and the possibilities are nearly endless. Bring your favorite board game, roleplaying game, miniature game, card game, or campaign group and settle in for an afternoon of gaming. Whether you arrive with a full party or come looking for fellow players, Sunday is one of the best times to connect with the local gaming community.

Roleplaying games are especially at home on Sundays. Gather your adventuring party, continue an ongoing campaign, introduce new players to the hobby, or launch something completely new. From Dungeons & Dragons to Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu, Star Wars, and countless other RPGs, our tables are available for stories waiting to be told.

Board gamers are equally welcome. Strategy games, family games, co-op adventures, deckbuilders, party games, and everything in between all have a place here. Our game library is available to browse, and you’re always welcome to bring games from home as well.

While open gaming is the heart of Sunday Game Day, we occasionally schedule organized events, demos, leagues, and special gaming activities throughout the year. If you enjoy tabletop gaming, we encourage you to bookmark the Paradox Comics-N-Cards event calendar and check back often. You never know when your next favorite game, campaign, or event might appear.

There is no entry fee for Sunday Game Day. Just bring your games, your imagination, and your sense of adventure.

event.description:
Meet up and chat with others with similar interests. Come with friends, or make some new ones! Refreshments will be provided.

Check the calendar for updates – https://larl.org/mondaymeetup/

First Monday of the Month – Craft Connection

Join us to get cozy, craft and chat! This is an opportunity to leave distractions behind and focus on your craft. Bring whatever project you are working on and meet up with other local crafters. You can share your expertise, learn from others or just enjoy some distraction-free time to yourself. Refreshments will be provided.

Second Monday of the Month – Best Sellers Book Club

Join the Moorhead Public Library’s Best Sellers Book Club and see what the buzz is about in the latest popular books!

Third Monday of the Month – Game Night

Join us to get cozy, play games, and chat! This is an opportunity to meet up with others who enjoy playing games. Come with friends, or make some new ones! Bring your favorite card or board game, or try one of ours! Refreshments will be provided.

Fourth Monday of the Month – Silent Reading Club

Join us at the Moorhead Library for quiet, sustained reading at our new Silent Book Club! All readers are welcome—ebooks or audiobooks, poetry or prose, fiction or non-fiction… it’s BYOBook. The library will provide comfortable seating and light refreshments.

Fifth Monday of the Month – Guided Activity

Join us each month for different activities lead by experts in their respective disciplines. Any needed supplies will be provided.

event.description:
Free & Open Play | All Skill Levels Welcome

Tuesday night is Commander night at Paradox Comics-N-Cards! Whether you’re a seasoned player with a carefully tuned deck or brand new to the format – or even to Magic – this night is for you.

Commander is all about big plays, wild moments, and great company, and we’ve created a space that makes it easy to jump in. Bring your own pod or come solo – our staff is happy to help you find a game, and many of our regulars love welcoming new players to the table.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Free, casual open play from 5PM to 10PM (or earlier – tables are open all day!)
  • A welcoming and inclusive atmosphere
  • Plenty of Commander fans ready to shuffle up and play
  • Staff support if you’re new, need help finding a game, or have questions

Whether you’re local to Fargo–Moorhead or just visiting, Tuesday nights at Paradox are one of the best ways to connect with the Commander community. No need to register – just bring your deck and join the fun!

event.description:
Loud enough to sing along. Loose enough to dance. Strong enough to order another.
We’re turning Tuesdays into a full-on dive bar music night. Barstool Sessions is all about live music, cold drinks, bad decisions, and good times—right here at Mick’s Office.
We rotate every Tuesday:
 Open Mic Night
 7:30 PM – 10:30 PM
Got songs? Got guts? Grab the mic.
• Play 2–3 songs
• First come, first serve
• Paper sign-up sheet out at 6:30 PM
• No frills, no filters, just real music
 Gig Night – Paid
One local artist takes over from 7:30–9:30 PM, playing the hits, the favorites, and the kind of songs that get the bar singing, swaying, and spilling beer.
The goal: Get people dancing by the jukebox, singing like they mean it, and drinking like it’s Tuesday (because it is). We want artists to grow, bring their friends, scribble their socials on the chalkboard, and help us turn Mick’s Office into a weekly music-fueled mess—in the best way possible.
Pull up a barstool. Yell the lyrics. Buy the next round.

There is something special about sitting down at a table with a good game, a few friends, and no rush to be anywhere else.

Every Thursday night, Paradox Comics-N-Cards opens the tables for a completely free evening of casual board gaming. Whether you are bringing your longtime favorite game, trying something brand new, or simply looking for a place to meet other people who enjoy boardgames, Thursday night is the perfect time to hang out at 814 Main Avenue. It’s relaxed, welcoming, and easy to jump into.

Bring your own games, teach something you love, learn something new, or just wander from table to table seeing what everyone is playing. Some groups will be deep into strategy games. Others might be laughing through party games, battling through co-op adventures, or introducing new players to modern board gaming for the very first time. No tournament pressure. No entry fee. Just a great night of gaming with good people.

You do not need a full group to attend. One of the best parts of board game night is meeting new players and discovering games you may never have tried otherwise. If you are new to tabletop gaming, this is also a great way to get started. Our community is filled with people who love sharing the hobby.

Our game library will be available to browse throughout the evening, and you are always welcome to bring games from home as well. Feel free to arrive early, stay late, grab snacks, settle in, and make a night of it.

If you have been looking for a regular place to unplug for a few hours, roll some dice, play some cards, and spend time with other gamers, Thursday nights at Paradox are for you.

Safe Harbor is a small, in-person, facilitated community peer-support and emotional processing group set up to offer more human connection.

The group will run in 4-week closed cycles, with up to 10 members each cycle, and will be meeting for about 90 minutes on the weekend. This is a non-therapy, community-based space, and it is not a substitute for therapy or crisis services.

Safe Harbor may be a good fit for people experiencing grief, transition, relational stress, feeling overwhelmed, or just wanting a place to process life with others humans.

Please note, this group is not a fit for anyone in immediate crisis. If you need urgent support, please call or text 988.

If you are interested, you can learn more about the group, facilitator, and also complete a quick interest form at safeharborfm.org

event.description:
Catering to families with young skaters, this Saturday morning session offers discounted admission for families along with age-appropriate music and skating aids at half off the regular price!

Help for Our Youngest Skaters

Our Family Skate is great for our newest skaters! We have Zippy Adjustable Skates, which go over the shoe, have a lower and wider wheel base, and roll more slowly. These are great for learning balance. We also rent Skate Mates for skaters aged 10 and under for $2.50 which is 1/2 off the regular price.

Discounted Admission for All

As families grow so do the expenses to go out and have fun together. We want to help and so during our Family Skate you can enjoy a lower admission at just $6 per skater. Don’t have your own skates? No problem! Rent your choice of inline or roller skates for just $4.00.

Themed Skate Sessions

Our Family Skate is a great session to host themed skates throughout the year. Whether celebrating a holiday or creating our own fun with a Superhero Skate, these can feature costumes, festivities and prizes, and themed music! Themed events may have special pricing on Admission.

event.description:
There is something special about a room full of gamers.

On any given Sunday at Paradox Comics-N-Cards, you might find adventurers exploring a forgotten dungeon, heroes saving a kingdom, rival starships battling across a tabletop, commanders shuffling up for one more game, or friends gathered around a board game they have been meaning to try for months. Sunday Game Day is our weekly celebration of tabletop gaming in all its forms.

The tables are open, the community is welcoming, and the possibilities are nearly endless. Bring your favorite board game, roleplaying game, miniature game, card game, or campaign group and settle in for an afternoon of gaming. Whether you arrive with a full party or come looking for fellow players, Sunday is one of the best times to connect with the local gaming community.

Roleplaying games are especially at home on Sundays. Gather your adventuring party, continue an ongoing campaign, introduce new players to the hobby, or launch something completely new. From Dungeons & Dragons to Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu, Star Wars, and countless other RPGs, our tables are available for stories waiting to be told.

Board gamers are equally welcome. Strategy games, family games, co-op adventures, deckbuilders, party games, and everything in between all have a place here. Our game library is available to browse, and you’re always welcome to bring games from home as well.

While open gaming is the heart of Sunday Game Day, we occasionally schedule organized events, demos, leagues, and special gaming activities throughout the year. If you enjoy tabletop gaming, we encourage you to bookmark the Paradox Comics-N-Cards event calendar and check back often. You never know when your next favorite game, campaign, or event might appear.

There is no entry fee for Sunday Game Day. Just bring your games, your imagination, and your sense of adventure.

event.description:
Meet up and chat with others with similar interests. Come with friends, or make some new ones! Refreshments will be provided.

Check the calendar for updates – https://larl.org/mondaymeetup/

First Monday of the Month – Craft Connection

Join us to get cozy, craft and chat! This is an opportunity to leave distractions behind and focus on your craft. Bring whatever project you are working on and meet up with other local crafters. You can share your expertise, learn from others or just enjoy some distraction-free time to yourself. Refreshments will be provided.

Second Monday of the Month – Best Sellers Book Club

Join the Moorhead Public Library’s Best Sellers Book Club and see what the buzz is about in the latest popular books!

Third Monday of the Month – Game Night

Join us to get cozy, play games, and chat! This is an opportunity to meet up with others who enjoy playing games. Come with friends, or make some new ones! Bring your favorite card or board game, or try one of ours! Refreshments will be provided.

Fourth Monday of the Month – Silent Reading Club

Join us at the Moorhead Library for quiet, sustained reading at our new Silent Book Club! All readers are welcome—ebooks or audiobooks, poetry or prose, fiction or non-fiction… it’s BYOBook. The library will provide comfortable seating and light refreshments.

Fifth Monday of the Month – Guided Activity

Join us each month for different activities lead by experts in their respective disciplines. Any needed supplies will be provided.

event.description:
Free & Open Play | All Skill Levels Welcome

Tuesday night is Commander night at Paradox Comics-N-Cards! Whether you’re a seasoned player with a carefully tuned deck or brand new to the format – or even to Magic – this night is for you.

Commander is all about big plays, wild moments, and great company, and we’ve created a space that makes it easy to jump in. Bring your own pod or come solo – our staff is happy to help you find a game, and many of our regulars love welcoming new players to the table.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Free, casual open play from 5PM to 10PM (or earlier – tables are open all day!)
  • A welcoming and inclusive atmosphere
  • Plenty of Commander fans ready to shuffle up and play
  • Staff support if you’re new, need help finding a game, or have questions

Whether you’re local to Fargo–Moorhead or just visiting, Tuesday nights at Paradox are one of the best ways to connect with the Commander community. No need to register – just bring your deck and join the fun!

event.description:
Join us for the third and final event of the inaugural Never Quitters conversation series. Inspired by Howard Dahl’s book of the same name, this fall series celebrates the people who bet big on North Dakota and helped shape its future.

This evening features former U.S. Senator Heidi Heitkamp. Throughout her career, Heidi has been a tireless advocate for North Dakota, helping advance priorities that strengthened agriculture, expanded opportunity, and brought national attention to the state’s future. Her ability to build relationships and find common ground made her one of the state’s most influential voices in Washington.

Hosted by her brother, former North Dakota Senator and KFGO radio host Joel Heitkamp, the conversation will reflect on a lifetime of public service, the moments that mattered most, and what it means to lead with conviction while never losing sight of the people you serve.

event.description:
Loud enough to sing along. Loose enough to dance. Strong enough to order another.
We’re turning Tuesdays into a full-on dive bar music night. Barstool Sessions is all about live music, cold drinks, bad decisions, and good times—right here at Mick’s Office.
We rotate every Tuesday:
 Open Mic Night
 7:30 PM – 10:30 PM
Got songs? Got guts? Grab the mic.
• Play 2–3 songs
• First come, first serve
• Paper sign-up sheet out at 6:30 PM
• No frills, no filters, just real music
 Gig Night – Paid
One local artist takes over from 7:30–9:30 PM, playing the hits, the favorites, and the kind of songs that get the bar singing, swaying, and spilling beer.
The goal: Get people dancing by the jukebox, singing like they mean it, and drinking like it’s Tuesday (because it is). We want artists to grow, bring their friends, scribble their socials on the chalkboard, and help us turn Mick’s Office into a weekly music-fueled mess—in the best way possible.
Pull up a barstool. Yell the lyrics. Buy the next round.

event.description:
There is something special about sitting down at a table with a good game, a few friends, and no rush to be anywhere else.

Every Thursday night, Paradox Comics-N-Cards opens the tables for a completely free evening of casual board gaming. Whether you are bringing your longtime favorite game, trying something brand new, or simply looking for a place to meet other people who enjoy boardgames, Thursday night is the perfect time to hang out at 814 Main Avenue. It’s relaxed, welcoming, and easy to jump into.

Bring your own games, teach something you love, learn something new, or just wander from table to table seeing what everyone is playing. Some groups will be deep into strategy games. Others might be laughing through party games, battling through co-op adventures, or introducing new players to modern board gaming for the very first time. No tournament pressure. No entry fee. Just a great night of gaming with good people.

You do not need a full group to attend. One of the best parts of board game night is meeting new players and discovering games you may never have tried otherwise. If you are new to tabletop gaming, this is also a great way to get started. Our community is filled with people who love sharing the hobby.

Our game library will be available to browse throughout the evening, and you are always welcome to bring games from home as well. Feel free to arrive early, stay late, grab snacks, settle in, and make a night of it.

If you have been looking for a regular place to unplug for a few hours, roll some dice, play some cards, and spend time with other gamers, Thursday nights at Paradox are for you.

Free & Open Play | All Skill Levels Welcome

Friday night is Commander night at Paradox Comics-N-Cards! Whether you’re a seasoned player with a carefully tuned deck or brand new to the format – or even to Magic – this night is for you.

Commander is all about big plays, wild moments, and great company, and we’ve created a space that makes it easy to jump in. Bring your own pod or come solo – our staff is happy to help you find a game, and many of our regulars love welcoming new players to the table.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Free, casual open play from 5PM to 10PM (or earlier – tables are open all day!)
  • A welcoming and inclusive atmosphere
  • Plenty of Commander fans ready to shuffle up and play
  • Staff support if you’re new, need help finding a game, or have questions

Whether you’re local to Fargo-Moorhead or just visiting, Friday nights at Paradox are one of the best ways to connect with the Commander community. No need to register – just bring your deck and join the fun!

event.description:
Safe Harbor is a small, in-person, facilitated community peer-support and emotional processing group set up to offer more human connection.

The group will run in 4-week closed cycles, with up to 10 members each cycle, and will be meeting for about 90 minutes on the weekend. This is a non-therapy, community-based space, and it is not a substitute for therapy or crisis services.

Safe Harbor may be a good fit for people experiencing grief, transition, relational stress, feeling overwhelmed, or just wanting a place to process life with others humans.

Please note, this group is not a fit for anyone in immediate crisis. If you need urgent support, please call or text 988.

If you are interested, you can learn more about the group, facilitator, and also complete a quick interest form at safeharborfm.org

Help for Our Youngest Skaters

Our Family Skate is great for our newest skaters! We have Zippy Adjustable Skates, which go over the shoe, have a lower and wider wheel base, and roll more slowly. Discounted Admission for All

As families grow so do the expenses to go out and have fun together. We want to help and so during our Family Skate you can enjoy a lower admission at just $6 per skater. Don’t have your own skates? No problem! Rent your choice of inline or roller skates for just $4.00.

Themed Skate Sessions

Our Family Skate is a great session to host themed skates throughout the year. Whether celebrating a holiday or creating our own fun with a Superhero Skate, these can feature costumes, festivities and prizes, and themed music! Themed events may have special pricing on Admission.

event.description:
NEW SCRIPT IN FARGO: DIRTY MONEY
A corporate cover-up. Arson. Financial fraud. And a killer determined to make everyone involved pay.
Join The Dinner Detective for Dirty Money, a brand-new interactive comedy murder mystery dinner show in Fargo! Help uncover the truth behind a devastating crime while a killer, driven by grief and revenge, targets the people who buried it.
Show dates: October 3, October 31, November 14, November 28, and December 26
Saturdays, 6–9 PM
October 31 is our Costume Show! Come dressed up for a Halloween night of mystery.
Enjoy a full plated dinner while you follow clues, question suspects, and try to solve the case. The culprit is hiding somewhere in the room and you could become a Prime Suspect before the night is over!
The Dinner Detective is North America’s largest interactive comedy true-crime murder mystery dinner theatre show. Our actors blend into the audience instead of appearing in obvious costumes, making every conversation part of the fun. Your ticket includes the show, dinner, waitstaff gratuity, and plenty of surprises.
Gather your fellow sleuths and book your seats for Dirty Money’s Fargo debut!

event.description:
There is something special about a room full of gamers.

On any given Sunday at Paradox Comics-N-Cards, you might find adventurers exploring a forgotten dungeon, heroes saving a kingdom, rival starships battling across a tabletop, commanders shuffling up for one more game, or friends gathered around a board game they have been meaning to try for months. Sunday Game Day is our weekly celebration of tabletop gaming in all its forms.

The tables are open, the community is welcoming, and the possibilities are nearly endless. Bring your favorite board game, roleplaying game, miniature game, card game, or campaign group and settle in for an afternoon of gaming. Whether you arrive with a full party or come looking for fellow players, Sunday is one of the best times to connect with the local gaming community.

Roleplaying games are especially at home on Sundays. Gather your adventuring party, continue an ongoing campaign, introduce new players to the hobby, or launch something completely new. From Dungeons & Dragons to Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu, Star Wars, and countless other RPGs, our tables are available for stories waiting to be told.

Board gamers are equally welcome. Strategy games, family games, co-op adventures, deckbuilders, party games, and everything in between all have a place here. Our game library is available to browse, and you’re always welcome to bring games from home as well.

While open gaming is the heart of Sunday Game Day, we occasionally schedule organized events, demos, leagues, and special gaming activities throughout the year. If you enjoy tabletop gaming, we encourage you to bookmark the Paradox Comics-N-Cards event calendar and check back often. You never know when your next favorite game, campaign, or event might appear.

There is no entry fee for Sunday Game Day. Just bring your games, your imagination, and your sense of adventure.

event.description:
Alt RPG Day goes monthly at Paradox Comics-N-Cards.

Dungeons & Dragons may be the biggest name in role-playing games, but it’s far from the only one—and some of the most exciting RPGs out there live just outside the D&D bubble. That’s what this day is for.

Each month we’ll be running non-D&D role-playing games. The exact systems will change month to month depending on what our DMs are excited to run—and that’s part of the fun. You don’t need to know the game ahead of time. You just need to show up ready to play.

This is a great day to:

  • Try a new RPG without committing to a campaign
  • Learn a system you’ve been curious about
  • Sit down with a table of players who want to explore something different

WE’RE ALSO LOOKING FOR DMs

If you’re a DM who loves non-D&D systems and wants an excuse to put something cool on the table, we want you.

  • Run what you’re excited about
  • One-shots or short arcs work best
  • DMs are paid in store credit
  • We’ll help seat your table and promote the day

If you’ve ever said, “I wish I had more chances to run this game,” this is that chance. Talk to us in the shop or message us if you’re interested in DMing an upcoming Alt RPG Day.

PLEASE BE AWARE: We will not update this web page with each month’s information. For the best way to find out what’s being run:

  • Call: 701.239.9505, Option 2. Ask for John Laitinen
  • Email: paradoxcnc.alpha@gmail.com
  • Follow us on Facebook or Instagram

Free & Open Play | All Skill Levels Welcome

Tuesday night is Commander night at Paradox Comics-N-Cards! Whether you’re a seasoned player with a carefully tuned deck or brand new to the format – or even to Magic – this night is for you.

Commander is all about big plays, wild moments, and great company, and we’ve created a space that makes it easy to jump in. Bring your own pod or come solo – our staff is happy to help you find a game, and many of our regulars love welcoming new players to the table.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Free, casual open play from 5PM to 10PM (or earlier – tables are open all day!)
  • A welcoming and inclusive atmosphere
  • Plenty of Commander fans ready to shuffle up and play
  • Staff support if you’re new, need help finding a game, or have questions

Whether you’re local to Fargo–Moorhead or just visiting, Tuesday nights at Paradox are one of the best ways to connect with the Commander community. No need to register – just bring your deck and join the fun!

We’re turning Tuesdays into a full-on dive bar music night. Barstool Sessions is all about live music, cold drinks, bad decisions, and good times—right here at Mick’s Office.
We rotate every Tuesday:
 Open Mic Night
 7:30 PM – 10:30 PM
Got songs? Got guts? Grab the mic.

event.description:
Want to play Dungeons & Dragons without signing up for a months-long campaign?

D&D One-Shot Wednesdays are exactly what they sound like: self-contained adventures that begin and end in one night. Show up, grab a seat, and play.

Every Wednesday, we run two tables of one-shot adventures, designed to work for new players, returning players, and long-time D&D fans. No ongoing story to track, no pressure to commit — just a good night of rolling dice and telling a story together.

What this night is good for:

  • Trying D&D for the first time
  • Playing when your regular group can’t meet
    Dropping in for a single night of adventure

We’re also always interested in hearing from Dungeon Masters who enjoy running one-shots. If you like telling tight stories and meeting new players, this night was made for you.

Happens every Wednesday. Start with one night — stay as long as you like.

event.description:
There is something special about sitting down at a table with a good game, a few friends, and no rush to be anywhere else.

Every Thursday night, Paradox Comics-N-Cards opens the tables for a completely free evening of casual board gaming. Whether you are bringing your longtime favorite game, trying something brand new, or simply looking for a place to meet other people who enjoy boardgames, Thursday night is the perfect time to hang out at 814 Main Avenue. It’s relaxed, welcoming, and easy to jump into.

Bring your own games, teach something you love, learn something new, or just wander from table to table seeing what everyone is playing. Some groups will be deep into strategy games. Others might be laughing through party games, battling through co-op adventures, or introducing new players to modern board gaming for the very first time. No tournament pressure. No entry fee. Just a great night of gaming with good people.

You do not need a full group to attend. One of the best parts of board game night is meeting new players and discovering games you may never have tried otherwise. If you are new to tabletop gaming, this is also a great way to get started. Our community is filled with people who love sharing the hobby.

Our game library will be available to browse throughout the evening, and you are always welcome to bring games from home as well. Feel free to arrive early, stay late, grab snacks, settle in, and make a night of it.

If you have been looking for a regular place to unplug for a few hours, roll some dice, play some cards, and spend time with other gamers, Thursday nights at Paradox are for you.

Safe Harbor is a small, in-person, facilitated community peer-support and emotional processing group set up to offer more human connection.

The group will run in 4-week closed cycles, with up to 10 members each cycle, and will be meeting for about 90 minutes on the weekend. This is a non-therapy, community-based space, and it is not a substitute for therapy or crisis services.

Safe Harbor may be a good fit for people experiencing grief, transition, relational stress, feeling overwhelmed, or just wanting a place to process life with others humans.

Please note, this group is not a fit for anyone in immediate crisis. If you need urgent support, please call or text 988.

If you are interested, you can learn more about the group, facilitator, and also complete a quick interest form at safeharborfm.org

event.description:
There is something special about a room full of gamers.

On any given Sunday at Paradox Comics-N-Cards, you might find adventurers exploring a forgotten dungeon, heroes saving a kingdom, rival starships battling across a tabletop, commanders shuffling up for one more game, or friends gathered around a board game they have been meaning to try for months. Sunday Game Day is our weekly celebration of tabletop gaming in all its forms.

The tables are open, the community is welcoming, and the possibilities are nearly endless. Bring your favorite board game, roleplaying game, miniature game, card game, or campaign group and settle in for an afternoon of gaming. Whether you arrive with a full party or come looking for fellow players, Sunday is one of the best times to connect with the local gaming community.

Roleplaying games are especially at home on Sundays. Gather your adventuring party, continue an ongoing campaign, introduce new players to the hobby, or launch something completely new. From Dungeons & Dragons to Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu, Star Wars, and countless other RPGs, our tables are available for stories waiting to be told.

Board gamers are equally welcome. Strategy games, family games, co-op adventures, deckbuilders, party games, and everything in between all have a place here. Our game library is available to browse, and you’re always welcome to bring games from home as well.

While open gaming is the heart of Sunday Game Day, we occasionally schedule organized events, demos, leagues, and special gaming activities throughout the year. If you enjoy tabletop gaming, we encourage you to bookmark the Paradox Comics-N-Cards event calendar and check back often. You never know when your next favorite game, campaign, or event might appear.

There is no entry fee for Sunday Game Day. Just bring your games, your imagination, and your sense of adventure.

event.description:
Loud enough to sing along. Loose enough to dance. Strong enough to order another.
We’re turning Tuesdays into a full-on dive bar music night. Barstool Sessions is all about live music, cold drinks, bad decisions, and good times—right here at Mick’s Office.
We rotate every Tuesday:
 Open Mic Night
 7:30 PM – 10:30 PM
Got songs? Got guts? Grab the mic.
• Play 2–3 songs
• First come, first serve
• Paper sign-up sheet out at 6:30 PM
• No frills, no filters, just real music
 Gig Night – Paid
One local artist takes over from 7:30–9:30 PM, playing the hits, the favorites, and the kind of songs that get the bar singing, swaying, and spilling beer.
The goal: Get people dancing by the jukebox, singing like they mean it, and drinking like it’s Tuesday (because it is). We want artists to grow, bring their friends, scribble their socials on the chalkboard, and help us turn Mick’s Office into a weekly music-fueled mess—in the best way possible.
Pull up a barstool. Yell the lyrics. Buy the next round.

event.description:
Want to play Dungeons & Dragons without signing up for a months-long campaign?

D&D One-Shot Wednesdays are exactly what they sound like: self-contained adventures that begin and end in one night. Show up, grab a seat, and play.

Every Wednesday, we run two tables of one-shot adventures, designed to work for new players, returning players, and long-time D&D fans. No ongoing story to track, no pressure to commit — just a good night of rolling dice and telling a story together.

What this night is good for:

  • Trying D&D for the first time
  • Playing when your regular group can’t meet
    Dropping in for a single night of adventure

We’re also always interested in hearing from Dungeon Masters who enjoy running one-shots. If you like telling tight stories and meeting new players, this night was made for you.

Happens every Wednesday. Start with one night — stay as long as you like.

event.description:
There is something special about sitting down at a table with a good game, a few friends, and no rush to be anywhere else.

Every Thursday night, Paradox Comics-N-Cards opens the tables for a completely free evening of casual board gaming. Whether you are bringing your longtime favorite game, trying something brand new, or simply looking for a place to meet other people who enjoy boardgames, Thursday night is the perfect time to hang out at 814 Main Avenue. It’s relaxed, welcoming, and easy to jump into.

Bring your own games, teach something you love, learn something new, or just wander from table to table seeing what everyone is playing. Some groups will be deep into strategy games. Others might be laughing through party games, battling through co-op adventures, or introducing new players to modern board gaming for the very first time. No tournament pressure. No entry fee. Just a great night of gaming with good people.

You do not need a full group to attend. One of the best parts of board game night is meeting new players and discovering games you may never have tried otherwise. If you are new to tabletop gaming, this is also a great way to get started. Our community is filled with people who love sharing the hobby.

Our game library will be available to browse throughout the evening, and you are always welcome to bring games from home as well. Feel free to arrive early, stay late, grab snacks, settle in, and make a night of it.

If you have been looking for a regular place to unplug for a few hours, roll some dice, play some cards, and spend time with other gamers, Thursday nights at Paradox are for you.

Safe Harbor is a small, in-person, facilitated community peer-support and emotional processing group set up to offer more human connection.

The group will run in 4-week closed cycles, with up to 10 members each cycle, and will be meeting for about 90 minutes on the weekend. This is a non-therapy, community-based space, and it is not a substitute for therapy or crisis services.

Safe Harbor may be a good fit for people experiencing grief, transition, relational stress, feeling overwhelmed, or just wanting a place to process life with others humans.

Please note, this group is not a fit for anyone in immediate crisis. If you need urgent support, please call or text 988.

If you are interested, you can learn more about the group, facilitator, and also complete a quick interest form at safeharborfm.org

event.description:
There is something special about a room full of gamers.

On any given Sunday at Paradox Comics-N-Cards, you might find adventurers exploring a forgotten dungeon, heroes saving a kingdom, rival starships battling across a tabletop, commanders shuffling up for one more game, or friends gathered around a board game they have been meaning to try for months. Sunday Game Day is our weekly celebration of tabletop gaming in all its forms.

The tables are open, the community is welcoming, and the possibilities are nearly endless. Bring your favorite board game, roleplaying game, miniature game, card game, or campaign group and settle in for an afternoon of gaming. Whether you arrive with a full party or come looking for fellow players, Sunday is one of the best times to connect with the local gaming community.

Roleplaying games are especially at home on Sundays. Gather your adventuring party, continue an ongoing campaign, introduce new players to the hobby, or launch something completely new. From Dungeons & Dragons to Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu, Star Wars, and countless other RPGs, our tables are available for stories waiting to be told.

Board gamers are equally welcome. Strategy games, family games, co-op adventures, deckbuilders, party games, and everything in between all have a place here. Our game library is available to browse, and you’re always welcome to bring games from home as well.

While open gaming is the heart of Sunday Game Day, we occasionally schedule organized events, demos, leagues, and special gaming activities throughout the year. If you enjoy tabletop gaming, we encourage you to bookmark the Paradox Comics-N-Cards event calendar and check back often. You never know when your next favorite game, campaign, or event might appear.

There is no entry fee for Sunday Game Day. Just bring your games, your imagination, and your sense of adventure.

Meet up and chat with others with similar interests. Come with friends, or make some new ones! Refreshments will be provided.

Check the calendar for updates – https://larl.org/mondaymeetup/

First Monday of the Month – Craft Connection

Join us to get cozy, craft and chat! This is an opportunity to leave distractions behind and focus on your craft. Bring whatever project you are working on and meet up with other local crafters. You can share your expertise, learn from others or just enjoy some distraction-free time to yourself. Refreshments will be provided.

Second Monday of the Month – Best Sellers Book Club

Join the Moorhead Public Library’s Best Sellers Book Club and see what the buzz is about in the latest popular books!

Third Monday of the Month – Game Night

Join us to get cozy, play games, and chat! This is an opportunity to meet up with others who enjoy playing games. Come with friends, or make some new ones! Bring your favorite card or board game, or try one of ours! Refreshments will be provided.

Fourth Monday of the Month – Silent Reading Club

Join us at the Moorhead Library for quiet, sustained reading at our new Silent Book Club! All readers are welcome—ebooks or audiobooks, poetry or prose, fiction or non-fiction… it’s BYOBook. The library will provide comfortable seating and light refreshments.

Fifth Monday of the Month – Guided Activity

event.description:
Want to play Dungeons & Dragons without signing up for a months-long campaign?

D&D One-Shot Wednesdays are exactly what they sound like: self-contained adventures that begin and end in one night. Show up, grab a seat, and play.

Every Wednesday, we run two tables of one-shot adventures, designed to work for new players, returning players, and long-time D&D fans. No ongoing story to track, no pressure to commit — just a good night of rolling dice and telling a story together.

What this night is good for:

  • Trying D&D for the first time
  • Playing when your regular group can’t meet
    Dropping in for a single night of adventure

We’re also always interested in hearing from Dungeon Masters who enjoy running one-shots. If you like telling tight stories and meeting new players, this night was made for you.

Happens every Wednesday. Start with one night — stay as long as you like.

event.description:
There is something special about sitting down at a table with a good game, a few friends, and no rush to be anywhere else.

Every Thursday night, Paradox Comics-N-Cards opens the tables for a completely free evening of casual board gaming. Whether you are bringing your longtime favorite game, trying something brand new, or simply looking for a place to meet other people who enjoy boardgames, Thursday night is the perfect time to hang out at 814 Main Avenue. It’s relaxed, welcoming, and easy to jump into.

Bring your own games, teach something you love, learn something new, or just wander from table to table seeing what everyone is playing. Some groups will be deep into strategy games. Others might be laughing through party games, battling through co-op adventures, or introducing new players to modern board gaming for the very first time. No tournament pressure. No entry fee. Just a great night of gaming with good people.

You do not need a full group to attend. One of the best parts of board game night is meeting new players and discovering games you may never have tried otherwise. If you are new to tabletop gaming, this is also a great way to get started. Our community is filled with people who love sharing the hobby.

Our game library will be available to browse throughout the evening, and you are always welcome to bring games from home as well. Feel free to arrive early, stay late, grab snacks, settle in, and make a night of it.

If you have been looking for a regular place to unplug for a few hours, roll some dice, play some cards, and spend time with other gamers, Thursday nights at Paradox are for you.

Free & Open Play | All Skill Levels Welcome

Friday night is Commander night at Paradox Comics-N-Cards! Whether you’re a seasoned player with a carefully tuned deck or brand new to the format – or even to Magic – this night is for you.

Commander is all about big plays, wild moments, and great company, and we’ve created a space that makes it easy to jump in. Bring your own pod or come solo – our staff is happy to help you find a game, and many of our regulars love welcoming new players to the table.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Free, casual open play from 5PM to 10PM (or earlier – tables are open all day!)
  • A welcoming and inclusive atmosphere
  • Plenty of Commander fans ready to shuffle up and play
  • Staff support if you’re new, need help finding a game, or have questions

Whether you’re local to Fargo-Moorhead or just visiting, Friday nights at Paradox are one of the best ways to connect with the Commander community. No need to register – just bring your deck and join the fun!

event.description:
Safe Harbor is a small, in-person, facilitated community peer-support and emotional processing group set up to offer more human connection.

The group will run in 4-week closed cycles, with up to 10 members each cycle, and will be meeting for about 90 minutes on the weekend. This is a non-therapy, community-based space, and it is not a substitute for therapy or crisis services.

Safe Harbor may be a good fit for people experiencing grief, transition, relational stress, feeling overwhelmed, or just wanting a place to process life with others humans.

Please note, this group is not a fit for anyone in immediate crisis. If you need urgent support, please call or text 988.

If you are interested, you can learn more about the group, facilitator, and also complete a quick interest form at safeharborfm.org

event.description:
There is something special about a room full of gamers.

On any given Sunday at Paradox Comics-N-Cards, you might find adventurers exploring a forgotten dungeon, heroes saving a kingdom, rival starships battling across a tabletop, commanders shuffling up for one more game, or friends gathered around a board game they have been meaning to try for months. Sunday Game Day is our weekly celebration of tabletop gaming in all its forms.

The tables are open, the community is welcoming, and the possibilities are nearly endless. Bring your favorite board game, roleplaying game, miniature game, card game, or campaign group and settle in for an afternoon of gaming. Whether you arrive with a full party or come looking for fellow players, Sunday is one of the best times to connect with the local gaming community.

Roleplaying games are especially at home on Sundays. Gather your adventuring party, continue an ongoing campaign, introduce new players to the hobby, or launch something completely new. From Dungeons & Dragons to Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu, Star Wars, and countless other RPGs, our tables are available for stories waiting to be told.

Board gamers are equally welcome. Strategy games, family games, co-op adventures, deckbuilders, party games, and everything in between all have a place here. Our game library is available to browse, and you’re always welcome to bring games from home as well.

While open gaming is the heart of Sunday Game Day, we occasionally schedule organized events, demos, leagues, and special gaming activities throughout the year. If you enjoy tabletop gaming, we encourage you to bookmark the Paradox Comics-N-Cards event calendar and check back often. You never know when your next favorite game, campaign, or event might appear.

There is no entry fee for Sunday Game Day. Just bring your games, your imagination, and your sense of adventure.

event.description:
Meet up and chat with others with similar interests. Come with friends, or make some new ones! Refreshments will be provided.

Check the calendar for updates – https://larl.org/mondaymeetup/

First Monday of the Month – Craft Connection

Join us to get cozy, craft and chat! This is an opportunity to leave distractions behind and focus on your craft. Bring whatever project you are working on and meet up with other local crafters. You can share your expertise, learn from others or just enjoy some distraction-free time to yourself. Refreshments will be provided.

Second Monday of the Month – Best Sellers Book Club

Join the Moorhead Public Library’s Best Sellers Book Club and see what the buzz is about in the latest popular books!

Third Monday of the Month – Game Night

Join us to get cozy, play games, and chat! This is an opportunity to meet up with others who enjoy playing games. Come with friends, or make some new ones! Bring your favorite card or board game, or try one of ours! Refreshments will be provided.

Fourth Monday of the Month – Silent Reading Club

Join us at the Moorhead Library for quiet, sustained reading at our new Silent Book Club! All readers are welcome—ebooks or audiobooks, poetry or prose, fiction or non-fiction… it’s BYOBook. The library will provide comfortable seating and light refreshments.

Fifth Monday of the Month – Guided Activity

Join us each month for different activities lead by experts in their respective disciplines. Any needed supplies will be provided.

Free & Open Play | All Skill Levels Welcome

Tuesday night is Commander night at Paradox Comics-N-Cards! Whether you’re a seasoned player with a carefully tuned deck or brand new to the format – or even to Magic – this night is for you.

Commander is all about big plays, wild moments, and great company, and we’ve created a space that makes it easy to jump in. Bring your own pod or come solo – our staff is happy to help you find a game, and many of our regulars love welcoming new players to the table.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Free, casual open play from 5PM to 10PM (or earlier – tables are open all day!)
  • A welcoming and inclusive atmosphere
  • Plenty of Commander fans ready to shuffle up and play
  • Staff support if you’re new, need help finding a game, or have questions

Whether you’re local to Fargo–Moorhead or just visiting, Tuesday nights at Paradox are one of the best ways to connect with the Commander community. No need to register – just bring your deck and join the fun!

event.description:
Loud enough to sing along. Loose enough to dance. Strong enough to order another.
We’re turning Tuesdays into a full-on dive bar music night. Barstool Sessions is all about live music, cold drinks, bad decisions, and good times—right here at Mick’s Office.
We rotate every Tuesday:
 Open Mic Night
 7:30 PM – 10:30 PM
Got songs? Got guts? Grab the mic.
• Play 2–3 songs
• First come, first serve
• Paper sign-up sheet out at 6:30 PM
• No frills, no filters, just real music
 Gig Night – Paid
One local artist takes over from 7:30–9:30 PM, playing the hits, the favorites, and the kind of songs that get the bar singing, swaying, and spilling beer.
The goal: Get people dancing by the jukebox, singing like they mean it, and drinking like it’s Tuesday (because it is). We want artists to grow, bring their friends, scribble their socials on the chalkboard, and help us turn Mick’s Office into a weekly music-fueled mess—in the best way possible.
Pull up a barstool. Yell the lyrics. Buy the next round.

event.description:
Want to play Dungeons & Dragons without signing up for a months-long campaign?

D&D One-Shot Wednesdays are exactly what they sound like: self-contained adventures that begin and end in one night. Show up, grab a seat, and play.

Every Wednesday, we run two tables of one-shot adventures, designed to work for new players, returning players, and long-time D&D fans. No ongoing story to track, no pressure to commit — just a good night of rolling dice and telling a story together.

What this night is good for:

  • Trying D&D for the first time
  • Playing when your regular group can’t meet
    Dropping in for a single night of adventure

We’re also always interested in hearing from Dungeon Masters who enjoy running one-shots. If you like telling tight stories and meeting new players, this night was made for you.

Happens every Wednesday. Start with one night — stay as long as you like.
